messages:
Tess (Finance): FYI: Feb invoice shows a $34k unallocated GPU line under project=hosted-models. We need a fast owner mapping for chargeback + check if any vendor credits can offset.

billing-bot: Alert: gpu_cost_anomaly project=hosted-models delta=+230% since 2026-02-10. See /alerts/178500.

Raj (Infra): Paste of top cost rows from cost API:
`2026-02-13 hosted-models gpu A100 $34,200 tags: team=null,customer=enterprise-beta,job=beta-embed-sweep`

Marta (ML): `beta-embed-sweep` is from our embedding experiments for the Beta customer. We had two batches accidentally on reserved instances. Oops.

Eve (Product): Product had negotiated a small vendor credit for Beta POC earlier this quarter. Can finance apply that credit to this invoice?

Tess (Finance): If it's an approved POC credit we can apply up to $10k automatically; rest needs documented approval. Do we have the credit code or PO?

Eve (Product): Credit code in contracts drive: BETA-POC-CREDIT-02. I'll attach the doc to the ticket.

Raj (Infra): Quick attribution query I ran:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --from 2026-02-11 --to 2026-02-14 --filter "job==beta-embed-sweep" --group-by template,instance_type
```
Shows two runs on `reserved-highmem` and one run on `preemptible`. Reserved ones total $28,900.

Tess (Finance): Provisional split: ML team (Marta) $18,900, Beta customer (applied credit) $10,000. Remaining $5,300 is platform allocation for shared infra. I'll create FIN-7001 and attach provisional invoice + contract credit.

Marta (ML): We'll absorb $18.9k. We'll also update sweep templates and add a submission checklist to avoid reserved templates.

Raj (Infra): Short-term: enforce `--team` tag, add pre-submit warning if template contains `reserved` or `no-preempt`. Also added an alert rule to email owners when daily GPU spend > $5k on any single job.

Tess (Finance): FIN-7001 created: "Beta POC credit allocation & GPU chargeback". Auto-approve applied for $10k credit. Remainder allocation requires manager sign-off. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-7001

billing-bot: Ticket FIN-7001 created by Tess (Finance)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-7001

Eve (Product): Thanks. I'll upload the credit doc and ping Legal for any follow-up.

Marta (ML): Adding postmortem to ML board and will re-run remaining experiments on preemptible nodes.

Tess (Finance): Great. Closing provisional allocation; will update books once FIN-7001 is approved. :white_check_mark:
